tei:div.tei:p: ༄/ /dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa'i bskang gso bsdus pa bar chad g.yul las rnam rgyal zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru tsa turmu kha ye/ 'dir stobs 'phrog dbang po'i thugs dam bskang bar 'dod pas/ spyan 'dren/ byon skyems/ gtor ma sngags kyis phul nas phyi nang gi mchod pa/ 'phrin 'chol rnams sngon du 'gro bas/ dbyangs dang bcas pa'am/ med kyang rung ste/ hūm̐ lha mchog mahā kā la mthu bo che/ /khyed la mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'bul ba ni/ /rta mchog g.yag rog lug nag khyi nag sogs/ /mthing nag dar gyi cod pan mang pos brgyan/ /rakta dmar chen khrag gi argham̐ dang / /dri ldan me tog la sogs nyer spyod lnga/ /rkang gling thod rnga la sogs rol mo dang / /dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho dza gad sogs/ /mchod sprin dngos 'byor yid sprul mkha' bkang 'dis/ /lha mchog mahā kā la'i thugs dam bskang / /lha chen nag po zhal bzhi'i༞ zhing skyong gzi ldan dbang phyug༞ bram ze gzugs can dpa' bo'i༞ yum chen g.yung mo nag mo'i༞ las mdzad gtum mo ljang khu'i༞ ser nag siṅga li ma'i༞ dmar nag srin mo chen mo'i༞ 'khor gyi zhing skyong tshogs kyi༞ dregs pa sde brgyad tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang / /'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskong gyur nas/ /rnal 'byor dpon slob nyams chag sos gyur cig /gdong bzhi dregs pa 'khor dang bcas pa yis/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa srung zhing skyong ba dang / /gnod byed dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlogs/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /ces thugs dam bskangs pa'i rjes su/ bshag pa/ bzlog pa/ bstod pa/ gtor 'bul sogs dkyus bzhin bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di yang zhing skyong gzi ldan dbang po'i rnal 'byor pa sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis/ gnyan lo tsā bas mdzad pa'i bskang gso rnying pa nas btus te/ dpon slob nyung ngus bskang gso stong tshar sogs bya ba'i slad du/

yon tan rin po che du ma'i 'byung gnas dpal sa skya'i lha chen rig 'dzin pho brang du sbyar ba 'dis/ chos skyong bram ze'i gzugs can dgyes par gyur nas/ bdag cag dpon slob byang chub bar du 'bral med du skyong bar gyur cig thams cad bkra shis/ bskang gso bsdus pa 'di dpon slob lnga man chad kyis brgya rtsa stong rtsa sogs byed pa'i skabs mgyogs par grub dgos pa'i dgag dgos kyi tshe ma gtogs sgrub pa po de las mang bas bskang gso brgya tshar sogs byed pa'i tshe las sla'i dbang gis bsdus pa 'di byas pa byung na/ zhing skyong dbang po nyid kyis tshar gcod pa dang / yang bskang gso rnying pa brgya rtsa stong rtsa sogs gang dgos pa'i steng du/ bsdus pa 'di yang spro bas byas pa la nyes par mi 'gyur zhing dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ bkra shis dang bde legs kyi dpal 'bar bar gyur cig/ // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa'i bskang gso bsdus pa bar chad g.yul las rnam rgyal/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
